speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They stayed. Twice in three days, a yard that hears every word, which is worse.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Worse than coughs. You gave them the whole of the old man, and they kept him. I am not asking you to be shorter the next time we give him.

speaker: margery_pell
text: They were not my Tuesday quiet. Tuesday was old men who had not heard of us. Nine shillings, and I said so then. Today they stood still for a tale. Still is not the same as thin, and I am not naming a new box.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not name one. I did not come off to count. I came off because the tale was done, and they had heard it.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The king is on my desk, not in this basket. You will not have a page of him to fret over in the passage. Six days was Tuesday. This is Thursday. I am in the middle, and the middle is not a report.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then keep the middle. I spoke an old man. The yard stayed for him. That is the afternoon.

speaker: john_heminges
text: And that is a play we know. Be content with a play we know. The other book goes when it is fair, and not when you are warm from a house that listened.

speaker: margery_pell
text: A good house is a manner of speaking. I had no shouting. I had attention, which is rarer, and worse for a man who hoped to be muffled.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I did not hope to be muffled. I did not hurry him. They had the length, and the length was the sense.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Then your virtue is safe. A poet in a tiring-house after a listening yard is a man who wants to mend a line. There is no line of yours in my basket for you to mend.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Home by the road. The gate looks at every face. You had your look on the way up. You will have it again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Same road. I am not writing him a better ending between here and the close.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Good. Endings are not my stair. My stair is swept. Off it, if you are done being noticed.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Noticed is enough of a word. Take it away, Master Will. I have ruling to do, and an audience of one is the wrong size.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They heard me. That is the fact I mean to keep, and the only one.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Keep it. Tomorrow is another play, and you are in that one too. Do not spend tonight inventing a trouble you have not seen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have seen nothing nailed up. If there is a paper, it has not come to this door.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Not to mine. I hear the yard, not the gates. Go and be a lodger.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: And leave the six days alone. Monday is the carry. You are not the man who carries.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not. The seven shillings stay where John set them. I am not asking to see the coin.

speaker: john_heminges
text: You will not see it. It is set by, and it is not spent, and it is not a subject for a passage.

speaker: margery_pell
text: If you write the quiet down, write it as a tale they heard. Do not write it as a sum. I have not given you one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not write a sum. The poem is still up. I may leave it up.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Let it stay up until you are ready to open it, and not before. One book at a time.

speaker: john_heminges
text: One book at a time. Out. I am locking a known play in, and I do not want an epilogue on the step.
